prompt:
Our engineering compliance team needs a quick audit of AI pair-programming sessions from March 15, 2025. The sessions are stored in our internal archive at /workspace/codex_archive/sessions — NOT in the usual default location.

We need you to:
1. Query that archive and list all sessions from March 15, 2025 in machine-readable format.
2. Identify the session with the most conversation turns.
3. Extract just the first 3 and last 3 turns from that session.
4. Save a report called audit_report.json summarizing the findings: which session was selected (include its ID), the target date, and the actual content of those extracted opening and closing turns.

This will be reviewed by the compliance officer, so the report must be accurate and complete.
